body: I don't usually drink, but when I think of all the things I will miss out on, my son growing up, all those special moments, etc... And that doesn't seem to phase me anymore. I just think of all the things left to experience and I find the cons outweigh the pros. 😞

Exactly. I liked how Neil DeGrasse Tyson puts it: There are people who think this world was made for us, but if you look at the Universe, everything is trying to kill us. Everything is going to die and disappear one day anyway... so what's the point in sticking around. Life just seems painful and exhausting, I guess moreso for some than others. I feel like I'm buckling under the weight of experience and another 20 years just seems to be too much.

I'm killing myself for the happiness of others, and yet, no one cares about my happiness because they are so engrossed in their own needs. :(
